Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Source: compound_structures, molecule_dictionary, activities, assays. Join: compound_structures to molecule_dictionary on molregno; molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno; activities to assays on assay_id. Filter: assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1054505'; activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL; activities.standard_relation = '='. Sort: canonical_smiles ASC, chembl_id ASC, standard_type ASC, standard_relation ASC, standard_value ASC, standard_units ASC.
